title: CEON: Circular Economy Ontology Network
abstract: arXiv:2606.02253v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Increasing the circularity of resource use in our society has been recognized as a path to sustainability, i.e., transitioning into a more circular economy. There are many different circular strategies to do so, such as reusing products and components, refurbishing and remanufacturing used products, or recycling left-over or used materials. To enable these strategies, it is necessary to share information at the infrastructure level and to communicate between industry sectors along the product life cycle. Enabling semantic interoperability in this information sharing and communication is therefore a key to increasing circularity. However, knowledge representation for the circular economy (CE) domain, which involves many relevant industry sectors related to product life cycles, remains challenging. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.02253v2 公告类型：替换版。摘要：提高社会中资源使用的循环性已被视为实现可持续发展的途径，即向更循环的经济转型。为此存在多种不同的循环策略，例如重用产品和组件、翻新和再制造二手产品，或回收剩余或使用过的材料。要实施这些策略，需要在基础设施层面共享信息，并在产品生命周期的各工业部门之间进行沟通。因此，在这种信息共享和沟通中实现语义互操作性，是提高循环性的关键。然而，涉及与产品生命周期相关的众多工业部门的循环经济（CE）领域的知识表示仍然具有挑战性。为弥合这一差距，我们在Onto-DESIDE项目中开发了循环经济本体网络（CEON）。该本体网络旨在...
tldr: 本文介绍了CEON，一个在Onto-DESIDE项目中开发的本体网络，旨在通过实现语义互操作性来解决循环经济领域知识表示的挑战，从而促进资源循环利用策略的实施。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CEON, an ontology network developed in the Onto-DESIDE project, aimed at addressing the knowledge representation challenges in the circular economy domain by enabling semantic interoperability, thereby facilitating resource circularity strategies.
